OD-B16-S01-T01.line: Down, good dogs. You still know my step.
OD-B16-S01-T01.direction: the hounds fawn around him without one bark

OD-B16-S01-T02.line: Light of my eyes, you came back to me. I never thought to see you walk through that gate again.
OD-B16-S01-T02.direction: bowl falls, wine spills, he kisses his head and both hands, weeping

OD-B16-S01-T03.line: Sit here, young lord. The stool is yours. I will find a place by the door.
OD-B16-S01-T03.direction: rises stiffly and sweeps the fleece aside

OD-B16-S01-T04.line: Keep your seat, stranger. Eumaeus will pile me brushwood. Tell me instead who you are, and what ship set you down on Ithaca.
OD-B16-S01-T04.direction: ducks under the lintel and sits beside him

OD-B16-S02-T01.line: A Cretan, then, and hard luck carried you here. Eumaeus, go quietly to my mother and tell her I am home. Her ears only, no crier in the yard.
OD-B16-S02-T01.direction: lowers his voice, glancing at the stranger

OD-B16-S02-T02.line: It is done. I take the low road and I say it to no one else.
OD-B16-S02-T02.direction: binds his sandals and starts down the farm road to town

OD-B16-S02-T03.direction: stands tall at the gate and beckons him out, unseen by the son

OD-B16-S02-T04.direction: sets down his staff and steps into the yard after her

OD-B16-S03-T01.line: Stand straight, son of Laertes. The years come off you now.
OD-B16-S03-T01.direction: golden wand across him; skin darkens, beard blackens, fresh cloak falls

OD-B16-S03-T02.direction: he ducks back through the low door, tall and shining

OD-B16-S03-T03.line: Stranger, you are changed. Some god is standing in this hut, and I have nothing here to offer you.
OD-B16-S03-T03.direction: starts back, drops his eyes, lifts both hands

OD-B16-S03-T04.line: I am no god. Why do you liken me to the immortals? I am your father, Telemachus, the man you have grieved for all these years.
OD-B16-S03-T04.direction: steps into the firelight, arms open

OD-B16-S03-T05.line: You are not my father. No mortal man makes himself young at will, and no beggar puts on a king in one breath. This is a god's work, and it is mocking my grief.
OD-B16-S03-T05.direction: shakes his head, backing toward the wall

OD-B16-S03-T06.direction: they cling and cry, shrill as birds robbed of their young

OD-B16-S04-T01.line: The Phaeacians rowed me home asleep and left me with their gifts on the shore. Now tell me plainly: how many suitors, and out of what houses?
OD-B16-S04-T01.direction: sits close, keeping his voice under the fire's noise

OD-B16-S04-T02.line: Fifty-two from Dulichium, twenty-four from Same, twenty from Zacynthus, twelve of Ithaca itself, with a herald and a singer beside them. A hundred and eight, Father, and we are two. Two men cannot stand against so many in that hall.
OD-B16-S04-T02.direction: counts them off on his fingers

OD-B16-S04-T03.line: Zeus and Athena stand with us, and they are worth more than a hundred spears. Carry every weapon out of the hall to the storeroom, and leave two swords, two spears, two shields where our hands can reach them.

OD-B16-S04-T04.line: I will go back and swallow their laughter without a word. Not my mother, not Laertes. No one hears this from me.
OD-B16-S04-T04.direction: takes up his spear and sets his face

OD-B16-S04-T05.line: Let Eumaeus walk the stranger down to town when the sun is high, and let him beg his bread there like any other.
OD-B16-S04-T05.direction: clasps his father's hand at the door

OD-B16-S05-T01.line: Ship the oars. We are inside the point, and their sail is nowhere.
OD-B16-S05-T01.direction: the ship slips into harbor ahead of the ambush

OD-B16-S05-T02.line: Hear it in the hall. Telemachus, son of Odysseus, has come home to Ithaca this hour, safe out of Pylos, and his ship lies drawn up in the harbor.
OD-B16-S05-T02.direction: the herald calls it from the courtyard stones

OD-B16-S05-T03.line: The suitors leave their seats and crowd into the yard, staring at one another. The boy they meant to bury is walking in through his own gate.
OD-B16-S05-T03.direction: steps aside as the crowd surges

OD-B16-S05-T04.line: The sea has failed us and their ship is past our teeth. Then take him on the road outside town, in the fields, before he stands in assembly and turns the people against us.
OD-B16-S05-T04.direction: leans in over the wine, voice low and fast

OD-B16-S05-T05.line: I will not lift a hand against a king's son until the gods say so. Ask Zeus for a sign first. If the omens come out favorable, I will strike the blow myself; if they do not, I tell you to leave him alone.
OD-B16-S05-T05.direction: sets down his cup and holds the table's eye

OD-B16-S05-T06.line: Antinous, your own father came here hunted, and Odysseus sheltered him under this roof. This is how you pay that debt, by plotting my son's death. Plot it again and every man on Ithaca hears it from my own mouth.
OD-B16-S05-T06.direction: comes down to the threshold, veil drawn across her face

OD-B16-S06-T01.line: Bend down again, old wanderer. The swineherd is on the path, and he must find nothing here but rags.
OD-B16-S06-T01.direction: wand touch; shoulders stoop, skin withers, the rags return

OD-B16-S06-T02.line: The prince is home and safe, and I put the word in the queen's ear myself. The ship that lay in wait for him came slinking into harbor with empty hands.
OD-B16-S06-T02.direction: drops his stick by the door, breathing hard from the road

OD-B16-S06-T03.line: In that same hour a man from the crew reaches Penelope with the same news, so the queen hears twice what the suitors dread once.
OD-B16-S06-T03.direction: turns the audience toward the palace

OD-B16-S06-T04.line: They eat their supper in the firelight and lie down. The father says nothing, the son says nothing, and the secret sleeps between them.
OD-B16-S06-T04.direction: lets the fire settle into embers

OD-B17-S01-T01.line: Eumaeus, bring the stranger down to town later in the day and let him beg his bread where he can. I go ahead to the house at first light.
OD-B17-S01-T01.direction: shoulders his spear in the gray dawn

OD-B17-S01-T02.direction: walks the long road and comes in through the courtyard gate

OD-B17-S01-T03.line: You are alive. Come here, child, let me look at you.
OD-B17-S01-T03.direction: the old nurse runs weeping and wraps him in her arms

OD-B17-S01-T04.line: Nestor gave me every honor but no news. Menelaus swore that the old sea god told him my father lives, held on an island by a nymph, with no ship to carry him. That is all I bring you, Mother. Nothing more.
OD-B17-S01-T04.direction: meets her eyes steadily, giving nothing away

OD-B17-S01-T05.line: Hear my oath, lady, by Zeus and by this table that took me in. Odysseus is on Ithaca soil this day, sitting still or already moving, and he is sowing death for these men.
OD-B17-S01-T05.direction: rises, reading the light in the doorway

OD-B17-S02-T01.line: Lean on the staff, old man. The town road is long and my legs are older than they look.
OD-B17-S02-T01.direction: shoulders the wallet and sets a slow pace

OD-B17-S02-T02.line: At the fountain of the nymphs, where the poplars stand in a ring, they meet Melanthius the goatherd driving the fattest goats of the herd down for the suitors' table.
OD-B17-S02-T02.direction: gestures toward the water and the descending flock

OD-B17-S02-T03.line: Look at this. One filthy tramp leading another down to beg at better men's tables. Out of my road, before my foot teaches you where the door is.
OD-B17-S02-T03.direction: shoulders past, kicking the beggar's hip

OD-B17-S02-T04.direction: hand tightens white on the staff, then loosens; he walks on

OD-B17-S03-T01.direction: stops still at the dung heap, seeing the old hound in the flies

OD-B17-S03-T02.line: The old hound knows him. He lifts his head out of the dung, drops his ears, and beats his tail, but he has no strength left to rise and come.
OD-B17-S03-T02.direction: the tail thumps twice in the filth

OD-B17-S03-T03.line: Eumaeus, that dog on the heap. There is a fine shape under all that dirt. Was he a hunter once, or only a table dog kept for show?
OD-B17-S03-T03.direction: turns his face away and wipes a tear unseen

OD-B17-S03-T04.line: Twenty years he waited, and one look was enough. The dark of death takes Argos in the moment he has seen his master again.
OD-B17-S03-T04.direction: the tail stills, the head goes down for the last time

OD-B17-S04-T01.line: Wait here at the threshold, friend, and come in when I call you.
OD-B17-S04-T01.direction: steps in first; the prince nods him toward the door stool

OD-B17-S04-T02.direction: sits on the ash-wood sill of his own house, listening to the singer

OD-B17-S04-T03.line: Give what you can spare, my lord. You have plenty and it costs you nothing. I was a rich man once with a house of my own, and I fed every wanderer who came to my door.
OD-B17-S04-T03.direction: moves down the tables with his hand out, reading each face

OD-B17-S04-T04.line: Man after man drops food in his bag, half from pity, half from habit. Then Antinous rises and demands to know who let this thing in through the door.
OD-B17-S04-T04.direction: sweeps a hand along the crowded tables

OD-B17-S05-T01.line: I had a house and men of my own once, and I gave to any beggar who came. Then Egypt swallowed it. My crew were cut down along the river and I was sold from hand to hand until I came to this door.
OD-B17-S05-T01.direction: holds out the bag, steady under the stare

OD-B17-S05-T02.line: What god dumped this plague on our dinner? Back from the table, you shameless thing, before you find an Egypt worse than the first.
OD-B17-S05-T02.direction: shoves the wine away and stands

OD-B17-S05-T03.line: Your body is handsome, but there is no mind inside it. Sitting in another man's house you would not give a grain of salt from a table that is not yours.

OD-B17-S05-T04.line: Take it then, and beg from where you fall.
OD-B17-S05-T04.direction: hurls the footstool into his right shoulder

OD-B17-S05-T05.line: Hear me, gods, and you avengers of the poor, if a beggar has any claim on heaven. Let Antinous meet his death before his wedding day.
OD-B17-S05-T05.direction: stands rooted as a rock, shaking his head slowly

OD-B17-S05-T06.line: Even the suitors cannot stomach it. One of them says aloud what all of them are thinking: strike a stranger at the door, and it may be a god you have struck.

OD-B17-S06-T01.line: They struck a guest in my own house and he bore it without a sound? Eumaeus, bring the man up to me. I want to hear where he has wandered, and whether he has heard any word of Odysseus.
OD-B17-S06-T01.direction: sets down the wool and leans forward

OD-B17-S06-T02.line: Not now, and tell her so kindly. There are hard hands in that hall, and one has already found me. Let me come to her at dusk when the light is gone.
OD-B17-S06-T02.direction: touches his bruised shoulder and nods toward the hall

OD-B17-S06-T03.line: The stranger is no fool. He sees these men for exactly what they are. Let him come when the hall empties, and he will sit by my fire and say whatever he likes.
OD-B17-S06-T03.direction: smiles faintly and draws her chair to the hearth

OD-B17-S06-T04.direction: a huge sneeze cracks off the rafters

OD-B17-S06-T05.line: Did you hear that? My words are sealed. Every one of these men will meet his death.

OD-B17-S07-T01.line: The pigs want me before dawn, my lord. Shall I go back up to the farm tonight, or is there something here you want done first?
OD-B17-S07-T01.direction: waits by the door with his stick

OD-B17-S07-T02.line: Eat first, then go. Come back at daybreak with good beasts for the table, and with whatever the country is saying.
OD-B17-S07-T02.direction: presses bread and meat into his hands

OD-B17-S07-T03.line: Keep well, both of you. I will be back with the light.
OD-B17-S07-T03.direction: clasps the prince's arm, nods to the beggar, and goes out

OD-B17-S07-T04.direction: settles into the ash by the door, counting faces in the firelight
